needsHttps: To use Bookeeper on your phone you need a secure address. Ask whoever runs the library.
needsHttpsWho: Whoever runs the library can turn on HTTPS access on the computer that hosts Bookeeper.
needsHttpsHow: Once the address starts with https://, open this page again on your phone.
